description: This PHP source file defines the InstallerDataRegistrationAPI class, which is a REST API controller handling installer data registration in the OrangeHRM project. It manages incoming POST requests to send registration data, utilizing utility and service classes to process the registration flow.

classes.name: InstallerDataRegistrationAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class that handles installer data registration requests, particularly POST requests for registering installer data during system setup.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests for the installer data registration. Checks registration consent, retrieves an instance identifier, sends registration data via a service, stores the registration data state, and returns a success or failure message.
